description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different configurations in detecting misinformation, with the x-axis representing various configurations and the y-axis showing accuracy percentages. The configurations are labeled as 'Ours', 'w/o comments', 'w/o text', 'w/o select', 'w/o emotion', and 'w/o cognition'. The accuracy values range from approximately 80.10% to 90.57%. The 'Ours' configuration has the highest accuracy at 89.84%, while the 'w/o text' configuration has the lowest at 80.10%. The bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in red, 'w/o comments' in orange, 'w/o text' in light blue, 'w/o select' in dark blue, 'w/o emotion' in yellow, and 'w/o cognition' in green. The chart is organized in a grouped bar format, allowing for direct comparison between the different configurations.
